neighbours.label: the verb after 'you' in a wish or condition about the addressee's experience ('hope you liked', 'unless you enjoy', 'kiss your X goodbye')
fire: Thanks for coming, and I hope you had a good time at the party.
Bring earplugs, unless you enjoy listening to snoring all night.
We baked these cookies ourselves, so we hope you like them.
Skip this museum unless you love staring at old pottery for hours.
Hey, I hope you liked the flowers I sent on Friday.
Don't sit in the front row unless you want to get splashed.
If the storm hits the coast, you can kiss your vacation goodbye.
Honey, I hope you enjoyed the trip as much as I did.
quiet: Thanks for coming, and I think the party went really well.
Bring earplugs, because the hostel gets noisy all night.
We baked these cookies ourselves, so they might be a bit uneven.
Skip this museum since it only shows old pottery anyway.
Hey, I sent the flowers to your office on Friday.
Don't sit in the front row because the seats are broken.
If the storm hits the coast, the vacation will be postponed.
Honey, the trip was as much fun for me as for anyone.
